cases.name: service: the deployed unit's four settings typed
cases.divergence: DELIBERATE DIVERGENCE from the pre-rebuild code, decided by the user 2026-09-20. M3a Task 3 added ServiceOptions.mpd_host and ServiceOptions.mpd_port, which say where the Music Player Daemon answers its control protocol for a channel whose sound is a stored playlist it holds. Both carry a default, so no recorded INPUT changed and no recorded REFUSAL moved: every case the archive refused is refused here with the same message and the same exit code, and the two new fields are checked last for that reason. What moved is the shape of the value a successful parse produces, which carries these two more fields. A second setting joined them the same day and the same way, mpd_rewind_s: how far back an MPD channel starts when the house comes back to it, added after the flat heard a channel resume the wrong file. It carries a default too, so the same holds - no recorded input changed and no recorded refusal moved; what moved is again the shape of a successful parse. A further field joined the same way on 2026-09-24, decided by the user (OPEN-WORK rank 188): hold_threshold_s, how long a key must stay down to be held rather than tapped, which a calibration now measures beside the dialling window instead of sharing its value. It carries a default, so no recorded INPUT changed and no recorded refusal moved; what moved is the shape of what is produced, which carries this one field more, placed after dial_window_s.
